q: Organic farming uses fertilisers of organic origin such as compost manure, green manure, and _____ instead of chemical fertilisers.
e: Organic farming uses fertilisers of organic origin such as compost manure, green manure, and bone meal instead of chemical fertilisers. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: The neem leaves consist of insecticidal ingredients and can be used as an _____.
e: The neem leaves consist of insecticidal ingredients and can be used as an insecticide. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Plant-based insecticidal soaps leave no nasty residue, are non-toxic to animals, and do not harm _____ insects.
e: Plant-based insecticidal soaps leave no nasty residue, are non-toxic to animals, and do not harm beneficial insects. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: The municipal and non-hazardous industrial wastes are converted to energy by direct burning in a process known as waste gasification or _____.
e: The municipal and non-hazardous industrial wastes are converted to energy by direct burning in a process known as waste gasification or pyrolysis. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: In waste gasification, organic content wastes produce a mixture of hydrogen and carbon _____.
e: In waste gasification, organic content wastes produce a mixture of hydrogen and carbon monoxide. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Bioethanol is produced by converting the sugar content of any starchy material into alcohol with the evolution of carbon _____.
e: Bioethanol is produced by converting the sugar content of any starchy material into alcohol with the evolution of carbon dioxide. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Biodiesel oil is synthesised from plant oils by removing the by-product _____ molecule, which is valuable for soap production.
e: Biodiesel oil is synthesised from plant oils by removing the by-product glycerine molecule, which is valuable for soap production. Biodiesel is a diesel-like fuel made from plant or animal fats as long-chain fatty acid esters.

q: The main purpose of wastewater treatment is to remove suspended solids, organic carbon, nutrients, inorganic salts, heavy metals and _____.
e: The main purpose of wastewater treatment is to remove suspended solids, organic carbon, nutrients, inorganic salts, heavy metals and pathogens. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Photocatalysts like binary metal oxides nanomaterials (e.g., $TiO_2$, $ZnO$, $Fe_2O_3$) are used to mineralise, decompose, and _____ pollutants.
e: Photocatalysts like binary metal oxides nanomaterials (e.g., TiO2, ZnO, Fe2O3) are used to mineralise, decompose, and oxidise pollutants.

q: Previously, tetraethyllead (TEL) was used as an anti-knocking agent, but nowadays it is replaced by methyl _____ ether (MTBE).
e: Previously, tetraethyllead (TEL) was used as an anti-knocking agent, but nowadays it is replaced by methyl tert-butyl ether (MTBE). Ethers have an oxygen bridged between two carbon groups and are often used as solvents.

q: Bioplastics are derived from renewable biomass sources such as corn starch, vegetable oils and _____.
e: Bioplastics are derived from renewable biomass sources such as corn starch, vegetable oils and fats. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: In the liquid $CO_2$ cleaning process, liquid carbon dioxide replaces _____ which pollutes groundwater.
e: In the liquid CO2 cleaning process, liquid carbon dioxide replaces tetrachloroethene which pollutes groundwater. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Large amounts of adipic acid are used each year for the production of nylon, polyurethanes, lubricants and _____.
e: Large amounts of adipic acid are used each year for the production of nylon, polyurethanes, lubricants and plasticisers. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Chemists developed a green synthesis of adipic acid using _____, which is converted by an enzyme in genetically modified bacteria.
e: Chemists developed a green synthesis of adipic acid using glucose, which is converted by an enzyme in genetically modified bacteria. Enzymes are protein catalysts that speed specific biochemical reactions.

q: Hexavalent chromium plating produces hazardous waste including lead chromates and barium _____.
e: Hexavalent chromium plating produces hazardous waste including lead chromates and barium sulphate. pH is the negative log of [H+], so a smaller pH means a more acidic solution.

q: Trivalent chromium plating uses chromium sulphate or chromium _____ as its main ingredient.
e: Trivalent chromium plating uses chromium sulphate or chromium chloride as its main ingredient. pH is the negative log of [H+], so a smaller pH means a more acidic solution.

q: Vermilion is a red pigment originally made by grinding a powder of cinnabar, which is mercury(II) _____.
e: Vermilion is a red pigment originally made by grinding a powder of cinnabar, which is mercury(II) sulphide. pH is the negative log of [H+], so a smaller pH means a more acidic solution.

q: Arsenic trisulphide ($As_2S_3$) is used as _____ in works of art because of its bright yellow colour.
e: Arsenic trisulphide (As2S3) is used as orpiment in works of art because of its bright yellow colour. pH is the negative log of [H+], so a smaller pH means a more acidic solution.

q: Clove oil contains eugenol, while mint oil contains menthol and _____.
e: Clove oil contains eugenol, while mint oil contains menthol and pulegone. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Cinnamon oil contains _____ as its major organic compound.
e: Cinnamon oil contains cinnamaldehyde as its major organic compound. An aldehyde has a carbonyl carbon attached to at least one hydrogen.

q: Solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass, biorefineries, geothermal, and _____ energy are important renewable resources.
e: Solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass, biorefineries, geothermal, and tidal energy are important renewable resources. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: The combustion of fossil fuel generates sulphur compounds whereas _____ does not.
e: The combustion of fossil fuel generates sulphur compounds whereas biodiesel does not. Biodiesel is a diesel-like fuel made from plant or animal fats as long-chain fatty acid esters.

q: Green materials such as agricultural waste adsorbent, activated carbon, and rice husk-derived _____ materials are applied in wastewater treatment.
e: Green materials such as agricultural waste adsorbent, activated carbon, and rice husk-derived ceramic materials are applied in wastewater treatment. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Lemongrass oil contains citronellal and _____ as major components.
e: Lemongrass oil contains citronellal and geranial as major components. The direction of this chemical relationship is the one chemists actually measure.

q: Rosemary oil contains 1,8-cineole, and oil of oregano contains _____.
e: Rosemary oil contains 1,8-cineole, and oil of oregano contains carvacrol. Cinnamaldehyde: an aldehyde has a carbonyl attached to hydrogen.
